# ATS Resume Checker

> Free in-browser ATS resume checker, resume builder, and cover letter generator designed to help job seekers pass applicant tracking systems (ATS) and land more interviews with instant diagnostic scoring.

## Core Tools

- [ATS Resume Scanner](https://atsresumecheckers.in/): Free online tool evaluating resumes across 30+ recruiting criteria, structural ATS parsing, keyword gap analysis, and instant scoring.
- [Resume Builder](https://atsresumecheckers.in/resume-builder.html): In-browser ATS-friendly resume creator with live preview, clean typography, and export options.
- [Cover Letter Generator](https://atsresumecheckers.in/cover-letter.html): Interactive cover letter generator tailored to job descriptions and company profiles.

## Career Guides & Resources

- [Resume Writing Guide](https://atsresumecheckers.in/resources/resume-guide.html): Comprehensive step-by-step guide to writing ATS-compliant resumes with quantifiable achievements.
- [Cover Letter Guide](https://atsresumecheckers.in/resources/cover-letter-guides.html): Strategies and frameworks for writing compelling cover letters that complement your resume.
- [Interview Preparation](https://atsresumecheckers.in/resources/interview-prepration.html): Proven frameworks (STAR method) and sample answers for technical and behavioral interviews.
- [Career Growth Tips](https://atsresumecheckers.in/resources/career-tips.html): Actionable career development strategies, salary negotiation insights, and networking practices.

## Legal & Information

- [About Us](https://atsresumecheckers.in/about-us.html): Background, mission, browser-side privacy commitment, and technology behind ATS Resume Checker.
- [Privacy Policy](https://atsresumecheckers.in/privacy-policy.html): Complete privacy disclosure detailing 100% in-browser document processing with no server uploads.
- [Terms of Service](https://atsresumecheckers.in/terms-of-service.html): Usage terms, intellectual property, disclaimers, and user responsibilities.
- [Contact Us](https://atsresumecheckers.in/contact-us.html): Inquiries, support requests, and user feedback form.
- [Disclaimer](https://atsresumecheckers.in/disclaimer.html): Educational and informational purpose disclaimer, third-party advertising disclosures.
- [Cookie Policy](https://atsresumecheckers.in/cookie-policy.html): Cookie categories, Google AdSense cookies, and user opt-out guidelines.

## Optional

- [Robots Configuration](https://atsresumecheckers.in/robots.txt): Crawler rules and indexing directives.
- [XML Sitemap](https://atsresumecheckers.in/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL directory for search engines.
